name: 道の駅 太良
desc: 有明海の干満の差を活かした「道の駅 太良（たら）」は、目の前に広がる穏やかな海景色が魅力のスポットです。最大の名物は、日本一の干満差が育んだ旨味たっぷりの「竹崎カニ」や「竹崎赤貝」。館内のレストランや直売所では、有明海の新鮮な海の幸を存分に味わえます。さらに、海を眺めながら利用できる源泉かけ流しの展望露天風呂（タラソ温泉）も完備され、旅の疲れを心から癒せる人気の道の駅です。
descEn: Situated along the coast of the Ariake Sea, "Michi-no-Eki Tara" offers breathtaking views of the calm sea shaped by the region's dramatic tidal changes. Its biggest culinary highlights are the renowned "Takezaki Crab" and "Takezaki Ark Shell," packed with rich flavor nurtured by Japan's largest tidal range. Visitors can fully savor these fresh seafood delicacies from the Ariake Sea at the on-site restaurant and market. Complete with a hot spring observation bath overlooking the sea, it is a popular destination where travelers can soothe their journey's fatigue and relax.
